Performance, Reliability & CI/CD Execute and support performance, scalability, and reliability testing for backend services. Partner with engineering teams to continuously improve testability, observability, and system resilience. Experience validating APIs, services, data pipelines, and complex backend workflows. Experience testing personalization, recommendation, or search platforms. Practical experience validating AI/ML-powered systems in production environments. Working knowledge of ML concepts, including features, training vs inference, evaluation metrics, drift, and bias. Experience validating data pipelines built on platforms such as Spark, Databricks, Kafka, or similar. Strong SQL skills for large-scale data validation.
